fact: BBC News Amharic reports the National Bank of Ethiopia ordered that from 23 Tahsas 2017 (December 2024) customers in Addis Ababa must present the Fayda digital ID to open a bank account, with nationwide requirement to follow within two years.
title: በአዲስ አበባ ከታህሳስ ጀምሮ የባንክ አካውንት ለመክፈት የ'ፋይዳ' መታወቂያ ማቅረብ ግዴታ ሊሆን ነው
